query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT exporterAddr AS __value, if(exporterName != '', concat(exporterName, ' (', exporterAddr, ')'), exporterAddr) AS __text FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY __text

panels.title: Traffic on interfaces with a known speed

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sumIf(bytes, inputSnmpIfSpeed > 0 OR outputSnmpIfSpeed > 0) / nullIf(sum(bytes), 0), 1) AS "Coverage" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)

panels.description: Share of bytes whose ingress or egress interface reported a speed via SNMP (ifHighSpeed). Utilisation panels below can only account for this share — if it is low, the headroom picture is partial, not healthy.

panels.title: Interfaces above 80% at peak

targets.rawSql:
WITH util AS (
  SELECT exporterAddr, inputSnmp, timestamp,
         sum(bytes) * 8 / 60 / (max(inputSnmpIfSpeed) * 1000000) * 100 AS pct
  FROM ${database}.samples(ival = 60)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND inputSnmpIfSpeed > 0 AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 60 SECOND
  GROUP BY exporterAddr, inputSnmp, timestamp)
SELECT count() AS "Interfaces" FROM (
  SELECT exporterAddr, inputSnmp, max(pct) AS peak FROM util
  GROUP BY exporterAddr, inputSnmp HAVING peak > 80)

panels.description: Ingress interfaces whose busiest minute in the range exceeded 80% of link capacity. Anything here is a capacity conversation, not an incident yet.

panels.title: Flows with no next-hop recorded

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf((nextHop IS NULL OR nextHop IN (toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0'), toIPv6('::')))) / nullIf(count(), 0), 1) AS "No next hop" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)

panels.description: Share of flows where the exporter reported no next hop — either NULL or the all-zeros address, which is how most exporters signal 'unset'. At 100% the routing panels below have nothing real to show.

panels.title: Ingress utilisation — top 10 interfaces

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT concat(if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr), ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp)))) AS dim
  FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND inputSnmpIfSpeed > 0
  GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) * 8 / (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime)) / (max(inputSnmpIfSpeed) * 1000000) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time, concat(if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr), ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp)))) AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $__interval_s / (max(inputSnmpIfSpeed) * 1000000) * 100 AS pct
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $__interval_s)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND inputSnmpIfSpeed > 0 AND concat(if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr), ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp)))) IN (SELECT dim FROM top) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: Percentage of link capacity used, per ingress interface, for the ten interfaces with the highest average utilisation. Capacity comes from SNMP ifHighSpeed (Mbit/s); interfaces without a speed are excluded entirely.

panels.title: Interface headroom — p95 and peak against link speed

targets.rawSql:
WITH util AS (
  SELECT concat(if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr), ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp)))) AS iface, timestamp, sum(bytes) * 8 / 60 AS bps,
         max(inputSnmpIfSpeed) * 1000000 AS speed_bps
  FROM ${database}.samples(ival = 60)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND inputSnmpIfSpeed > 0 AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 60 SECOND
  GROUP BY iface, timestamp)
SELECT iface AS "Interface", max(speed_bps) AS "Link speed",
       quantile(0.95)(bps) AS "p95 load", max(bps) AS "Peak load",
       round(100 * quantile(0.95)(bps) / nullIf(max(speed_bps), 0), 2) AS "p95 % of capacity"
FROM util GROUP BY iface ORDER BY "p95 % of capacity" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Per ingress interface: link speed, 95th-percentile and peak load over the range, and what fraction of capacity the p95 represents. Sorted by the tightest headroom. p95 is the number to plan against; peak is the number that hurts.

panels.title: Next hop — where traffic actually leaves

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(nextHopHostname, replaceOne(toString(nextHop), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Next hop",
       concat(toString(dstAs), ': ', ifNull(dstAsOrg, 'unknown')) AS "Destination AS",
       sum(bytes) AS "Bytes", count() AS "Flows"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND NOT (nextHop IS NULL OR nextHop IN (toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0'), toIPv6('::')))
GROUP BY "Next hop", "Destination AS" ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Volume grouped by the next hop the exporter recorded, paired with the destination AS. Use it to confirm a prefix is leaving through the upstream you intended, and to spot traffic taking a backup path.

panels.title: One-sided conversations — only one direction observed

targets.rawSql:
WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT least(srcAddr, dstAddr) AS a, greatest(srcAddr, dstAddr) AS b,
         countIf(srcAddr < dstAddr) AS fwd, countIf(srcAddr > dstAddr) AS rev,
         sum(bytes) AS total
  FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND srcAddr != dstAddr
  GROUP BY a, b)
SELECT replaceOne(toString(a), '::ffff:', '') AS "Endpoint A",
       replaceOne(toString(b), '::ffff:', '') AS "Endpoint B",
       fwd AS "A to B flows", rev AS "B to A flows", total AS "Bytes"
FROM pairs WHERE fwd = 0 OR rev = 0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Endpoint pairs where flows were seen travelling one way but never the other. Usually a visibility gap (an exporter or interface not configured for both directions) rather than asymmetric routing — either way, every byte-based comparison for these pairs is half a picture.

panels.title: Top source prefixes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(replaceOne(toString(tupleElement(IPv6CIDRToRange(srcAddr,
         toUInt8(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 96 + srcMaskLen, srcMaskLen))), 1)), '::ffff:', ''),
       '/', toString(srcMaskLen)) AS "Source prefix",
       sum(bytes) AS "Bytes", sum(packets) AS "Packets", count() AS "Flows"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND srcMaskLen > 0
GROUP BY "Source prefix" ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Traffic rolled up to the routable prefix the exporter reported (address masked to its prefix length) instead of individual hosts. Collapses a long tail of hosts into units you can actually act on in routing or policy.

description: Is any link running out of room, and is traffic leaving the way we intended? Capacity panels measure load against SNMP-reported link speed (ifHighSpeed, Mbit/s) and are blind to interfaces without one — the coverage stat says how blind. Routing panels cover next hop, prefix-level volume, and conversations we only see one side of. Scope with Tenant/Zone/Exporter.
